title: Environment variables
description: Every coding session's agent receives these variables.

page.notFound: This environment variable does not exist. It may have been deleted.

visibility.title: The agent can read every value
visibility.body: Every variable is placed in each session's environment, where the agent can read, print, or send it anywhere its tools reach.
visibility.secret: Secret means Elysium never shows the value again and the satellite scrubs it from session logs. Anything that must stay hidden from the agent does not belong here.

table.label: Environment variables
table.empty: No environment variables yet. Add one to give every coding session's agent a setting or token.
table.loadError: Environment variables could not be loaded.

form.keyHint: Letters, digits, and underscores, not starting with a digit, such as NPM_TOKEN.
form.valueHint: Passed exactly as written, including spaces and line breaks.
form.valueKeep: Leave blank to keep the current value.
form.valueReveal: Enter the value again to make this variable visible.
form.isSecretHint: Hide the value from Elysium after saving and scrub it from session logs.

errors.keyTaken: Another variable already uses this key.

keyRefusal.malformed: Use a letter or underscore, then letters, digits, or underscores.
keyRefusal.reservedForElysium: Elysium sets this variable for GitHub.
keyRefusal.reservedForSatellite: The satellite reserves every ARSOX_ variable, and never passes one to an agent.
keyRefusal.providerCredential: This looks like a model provider credential. The satellite's LLM proxy presents those on the agent's behalf.
keyRefusal.overriddenBySatellite: The satellite sets this variable for every session, so a value here would never reach the agent.

errors.valueRequired: A secret variable needs a value.

delete.title: Delete {{key}}?
delete.body: Sessions opened from now on no longer receive this variable. Sessions already running keep it.
